items.name: narration_en
items.direction: Narrate this as a popular geography YouTube Shorts channel. The Narrator is a deep, warm, confident storyteller: brisk and curious, with natural emphasis and a short comic pause before each punchline. Chars voices funny cartoon characters, short and punchy.
lines: Narrator
Your phone needs four satellites to know where you are.
Narrator
India built its own system. But for months, reportedly... only three worked.
Narrator
So last night, ISRO launched a fourth.
Narrator
But why does India even need its own G P S?
Narrator
Because a system someone else owns... can be weakened, or switched off.
Narrator
So India built NavIC: Navigation with Indian Constellation.
Narrator
It covers India, plus about fifteen hundred kilometres beyond its borders.
Chars
[cheeky, upbeat little satellite, fast and sarcastic] Three of us? That's just a triangle.
Narrator
Here's the catch: your phone needs at least four to fix your spot in three D.
Narrator
Old atomic clocks failed. And in twenty twenty-five, N V S zero two got stuck in the wrong orbit.
Narrator
So the team of four... became three.
Narrator
Enter N V S zero three: two thousand two hundred and thirty-two kilograms, carrying an atomic clock made in India.
Narrator
It's headed about thirty-six thousand kilometres up, to a parking spot above the equator.
Narrator
If it works... NavIC is back to four.
Narrator
So the next time your phone finds you... it might be listening to India.
Chars
[cheeky, upbeat little satellite, proud and slow] Three was a crowd... Four is a team.
Narrator
This is Bhoogol. Follow for more Geography Fun Facts.
